reviews.reason: With effective enumeration and dovetailing allowed, the necessity direction still builds a uniform adversarial forest for an arbitrary nongreedy LCL while maintaining disjoint-component color reservoirs, bounded depletion, Delta-regular incidence and computability. The bad-star obstruction forces a new label at every productive stage, turning an assumed total valid coloring into infinitely many productive stages although only finitely many labels exist. This coordinated graph/recursion construction supports H2; enumeration alone does not solve these obligations.
reviews.core_assessment: Read the original definitions62-108, standard conventions185-193, the whole counted statement and both proof directions270-374, before selector rationale. In the greedy direction, the Delta incident edge list is computable by search until Delta hits; only finitely many earlier vertices need be tested for adjacency, so computability of the true-edge predicate or degree is unnecessary. Greediness supplies central labels while previously colored neighboring vertices retain their already valid labels. In the converse, if s=|Sigma|>0, the newly obtained beta pool has at least N/s components; each repeated bad label is requested at most Delta times, so M=N/(Delta*s) full disjoint sets of witnesses can be chosen. Using only half of them for new centers leaves at least M/2 witnesses for each used label; unused labels retain their old disjoint pools. If beta is absent from the bad pattern, the unused old beta-colored(x_i,f_i) pool itself supplies its reserve. The new centers and remaining reservoirs lie in distinct components. Choosing N_0 as a sufficiently large multiple of(2Delta*s)^s makes every division integral and leaves a nonzero reserve after every possible active stage. Incidence at an introduced vertex is permanently fixed to its Delta edges; later attachments only add the other endpoint of an old virtual edge. Infinitely many candidate-initialization stages using least unused labels exhaust X and E, yielding decidable incidence. A correct total coloring would eventually converge on each fixed finite neighborhood after every active stage, contradicting at most s active stages.
reviews.prerequisite_assessment: Only the standard effective list and stage scheduling from185-193 is needed from the earlier proposition. No fullness theorem or long-path construction from the old public129440 is used. The nongreedy finite-star witnesses can be fixed effectively by finite search through the finitely many label subsets and star colorings. A forest is the required obstruction for COMPUTABLE as defined103; the stronger isolated tree wording312 is outside the counted claim.

issues.decision: The uncounted proposition312 says tree, but the supplied construction and Claim356-364 prove a forest. That is precisely enough for the counted characterization of COMPUTABLE on forests. The card excludes the stronger connectedness assertion and preserves the actual proof.

Choose the author freely specified sufficiently large N_0 divisible by(2Delta*|Sigma|)^|Sigma| for nonempty Sigma. The at-most-|Sigma| active-step bound then makes every displayed division integral and leaves a positive reserve. This instantiates a free integer choice rather than adding a new hypothesis.

When352 speaks of using(x_i,f_i) after naming new centersx_i=v_i, its witnesses must be the saved old-stage pairs from339 whose output is beta, as the stated reserve condition330 demands. There are at least N/|Sigma| such pairs, untouched if beta is absent from the bad pattern, enough for M/2. Renaming the new centers does not delete the existing vertices/edges. This is the explicit mathematical meaning of the available-pool choice, not a claim the proof is literal executable assignment code.

standard_prerequisites.name: Effective enumeration and dovetailing
standard_prerequisites.statement: Use disjoint infinite computable vertex/edge sets X,E in HF, a computable order of HF of type omega, an effective list phi_t of partial recursive maps X times E to the finite label set, and a computable stage schedule listing each t infinitely often.
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The same-source preceding construction185-193 sets these standard conventions.
standard_prerequisites.use: Enumerate every candidate computable coloring and allocate least unused labels. The nonstandard adversarial forest, reserve invariant and bad local patterns remain solution obligations.

core_obligations: For a greedy label set, enumerate vertices and color all incident half edges while preserving greedy labels on every edge with only one colored endpoint.
For a nongreedy problem, fix a bad finite star pattern for each available subset of labels.
Dovetail all partial computable candidate colorings and maintain separated components carrying sufficiently many reserved half edges of each known label.
At a convergent valid stage, force a previously unseen label and combine reserves using a bad star while retaining a large enough supply in distinct components.

Show at most |Sigma| such active stages are possible for each candidate, while a correct total coloring would force infinitely many; also verify the final forest and incidence relation are computable.

proof_roadmap.step: Effective greedy labeling without computing the actual neighbor-count function.
Initialize candidate-specific forests and the three reserve invariants; detect convergence on finite radius1 neighborhoods.
Use the bad star to force a new label and retain unused components, with a finite reserve budget.
Prove computability/acyclicity and diagonalize by finite versus infinite active-stage counts.

approved_task_config.difficulty_reason: The forward implication requires a tailored effective diagonal construction, not merely enumerating vertices. It stores label witnesses in separate components, combines them only through bad star patterns, quantitatively budgets their depletion, and forces a new label at each productive stage. This simultaneously preserves acyclicity and decidable incidence while defeating every total computable coloring, including when the true-edge predicate need not be computable.

compared.difference: The old item is the non-full obstruction on truly regular/highly computable forests, using bad long paths and vertex-multiset exhaustion. The new claim is the complete greedy characterization for all computable forests, using stars and half-edge label exhaustion.
